facts: Wells Fargo Bank, N.A., d/b/a America's Servicing Company, filed a foreclosure action against the Rodriguezes in 2010, alleging it was "the holder of the Mortgage Note and Mortgage and/or is entitled to enforce the Mortgage Note and Mortgage."
The copy of the note attached to the complaint was not indorsed.
Prior to trial, the bank filed the original note in the court registry, which contained an indorsement in blank.

At trial, the bank's witness testimony established that the bank was the servicer of the note and that the bank had possessed the original note since August 2007 -- i.e., well before the 2010 filing -- but the witness could offer no proof of when the blank indorsement was placed on the note, and no testimony was offered that the blank indorsement was on the note on the date suit was filed.
The trial court denied the homeowners' motion for involuntary dismissal (Fla. R. Civ. P. 1.420(b)) based on the bank's lack of standing, and entered final judgment for the bank.
facts_and_procedural_history.real_correction_found_this_run: The prior run's captured quote of the complaint's own allegation was truncated -- it read only 'the holder of the Mortgage Note and Mortgage.' The official opinion's actual quoted language is 'the holder of the Mortgage Note and Mortgage and/or is entitled to enforce the Mortgage Note and Mortgage,' which matters here because the disjunctive 'and/or is entitled to enforce' clause is the allegation the servicer-authority holding actually turns on. Corrected to the full, exact quote above.

holding_and_reasoning.summary_capture_method: Independently confirmed this run by directly reading the complete official opinion PDF -- SOURCE_VERIFIED confidence.
quoted_language: A crucial element of any mortgage foreclosure proceeding is that the party seeking foreclosure must demonstrate that it has standing to foreclose [at the time the complaint is filed].
The case law says the critical time for determining the status of the two core elements is the date the suit is filed.

A servicer that is not the holder of the note may have standing to commence a foreclosure action on behalf of the real party in interest, but it must present evidence, such as an affidavit or a pooling and servicing agreement, demonstrating that the real party in interest granted the servicer authority to enforce the note.
The bank introduced no power of attorney, pooling and servicing agreement, or other evidence to show that the real party in interest authorized it to bring the action.
holding_and_reasoning.quote_attribution_note: Independently confirmed this run: quoted_language[0] and [2] and [3] are from Ciklin, C.J.'s majority opinion. quoted_language[1] ('The case law says the critical time...') is, in the actual opinion, from Conner, J.'s special concurrence, not the majority -- disclosed here since the prior run's manifest did not distinguish it. It remains legitimate supporting authority for this graph's timing proposition (a concurring judge's own reasoning on the same panel, in the same case, expressly agreeing with and elaborating the majority's timing point), but is not majority holding language the way the other three quotes are.
holding_and_reasoning.real_correction_to_live_run_1_59_summary: Live Run 1.59's secondary-source summary described Rodriguez purely as a note-possession-timing case ('possession or a valid assignment obtained later does not establish standing retroactively'). The material captured (and, this run, independently confirmed against the complete official opinion) shows a real, material nuance Live Run 1.59 did not surface: the bank apparently already possessed the note well before filing (since August 2007), but sued in its own name as a servicer (d/b/a 'America's Servicing Company') without proving it had AUTHORITY -- via a power of attorney or pooling-and-servicing agreement -- to enforce the note on the real party in interest's behalf. The real holding combines a timing rule (standing/holder status must exist at filing) with a servicer-agency-authority proof requirement, not simply raw note-possession timing alone. This is confirmed accurate, not merely disclosed as a hypothesis.
